subject: Preflight gate review + commencement timing for Neptune proof-of-concept
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@neptunesys.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hargrave <tom.hargrave@orbital.io>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Timeline & gating items before POC kickoff

Michael —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We mapped the MAP to our internal evaluation calendar and want to lock the final go/no-go cadence so procurement and legal can schedule signers. Two quick asks:

1) Can you confirm the list of gating artifacts Redwood will provide by the technical review (SOC excerpt, data retention notes, and a 1-page eval checklist)?
2) We need a proposed signer window for execution (we're anticipating a two‑signer flow: Neptune legal + procurement). Can you sketch your recommended timeline for signature and a targeted POC start date?

I'd like to give our procurement team 72 hours notice before the DocuSign is routed.

Attachments: MAP_Neptune_v3.xlsx (mutual action plan, working draft)

—Elaine
Elaine Park

elaine.park@neptunesys.com

Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Timeline & gating items before POC kickoff

Elaine —

Appreciate the clear asks. High-level plan below, aiming to keep the POC kickoff during the week of Nov 16 if that still fits your internal rhythm. Internal owners are cc'd for approvals.

Gating artifacts we will ship before your technical review (by Nov 6):
- SOC excerpt: redacted control matrix + attestation summary (PDF)
- Data retention & deletion note (1 page)
- Eval checklist: targeted prompt set + success metrics (spreadsheet)
- Short ops runbook (what to expect during first 72 hours)

Signer windows and timing (recommended):
- Nov 9 — Redwood provides final SOW + minor redline window for Neptune legal
- Nov 11 09:00–17:00 PT — Primary signer window (DocuSign routed to Neptune legal then procurement)
- Target POC start date: Nov 16 (provisioning and orientation Nov 16–18)

If procurement needs 72 hours notice, we can plan to route DocuSign on Nov 8 to land in their hands by the 9th. Grace — can you confirm that the SOW will be production-ready for routing on Nov 8 and that we can generate the DocuSign envelope same day?

Lauren — please confirm if any finance approvals are required to be looped into the envelope.

Attachments: SOW_Neptune_v1.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 08:40 AM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> If procurement needs 72 hours notice, we can plan to route DocuSign on Nov 8 to land in their hands by the 9th.

Michael — I can get the SOW finalized and ready for routing on Nov 8. A couple of notes for the envelope:
- We should include a separate signature block for the 'data processing addendum' (DPA) that Procurement usually insists on; that avoids chasing two separate documents later.
- We will set the routing order: Neptune legal -> Neptune procurement -> Redwood ops. That keeps our provisioning trigger aligned with final procurement signature.

Lauren — any finance hold? If not, we can keep finance as FYI in the envelope (not required to sign).

Grace O'Connor

Grace, Michael —

This timeline works for us. Two quick confirmations from our side:
1) Legal will review the SOW and expect to return any minor redlines by EOD Nov 9. If you can route the envelope Nov 8 as discussed that gives us time to confirm the signers.
2) We prefer the POC to start Nov 17 rather than Nov 16 to onboard our ops people on a Tuesday — if you can shift provisioning to the 17th that would be ideal.

I will set procurement to expect the envelope and will share signer emails before routing.
